title: Lane lint's feedback inbox fixtures fail when the machine's mail auth fails
why: Lane batch-label-setter, 11:08 CST Nov 13: the "Feedback inbox fixture suite" in the lane lint fails in a container where hooks/mail.py prints "mail unknown: auth"; every hook-ran case sees the extra line, so a lane lint can FAIL from the machine, not the diff. Unmeasured on main.
note: The fixtures run with mail stubbed or ignore the mail status line, so the verdict depends only on the diff. Red case: a container with no mail auth. Express (ruling drain-first-hold part 4: a lint that fails for the wrong reason stops lanes landing).
